diagnostics.message: google_bigquery_routine.default has no dependency on google_bigquery_table.default, but a routine's definition_body is free-form SQL that typically references tables in the same dataset by name. BigQuery validates the routine's SQL at creation time, so if the routine queries a table managed by this module that has not been created yet, the apply fails. The module already expresses this ordering for views and materialized views via depends_on, but omits it for routines; an explicit depends_on on google_bigquery_table.default is needed.

google_bigquery_routine.default has no dependency on google_bigquery_table.views, but a routine's definition_body can reference views in the same dataset by name in its SQL. BigQuery validates the routine's SQL at creation time, so if the routine queries a view managed by this module that has not been created yet, the apply fails. An explicit depends_on on google_bigquery_table.views is needed.

google_bigquery_routine.default has no dependency on google_bigquery_table.materialized_view, but a routine's definition_body can reference materialized views in the same dataset by name in its SQL. BigQuery validates the routine's SQL at creation time, so if the routine queries a materialized view managed by this module that has not been created yet, the apply fails. An explicit depends_on on google_bigquery_table.materialized_view is needed.
